name: Zachariah Harris
source:
Zach is Ben's roommate for Freshman year. Ben has to be careful, as Zach is very shy and extremely introverted! Hopefully Ben's able to connect with him, otherwise it's going to be a long semester...

[Based on [url=https://stormsingerstudios.itch.io/santa-lucia]itch.io[/url]]

NOTE: He will get an individual route in future builds.
